Heckel analysis for the three material combinations with the negative natural logarithm of porosity (−lnε) against the compression pressure. The linear region of Heckel plot is analyzed after the first curvature where rearrangement processes take place. The following linear region is terminated by the second curvature, which is mainly caused by elastic deformation under pressure. The linear part in between the two curva­ tures is used for the linear regression. With increasing fraction of MCC, the slope of the linear region is increasing, which corresponds to a lower Py value (Fig. 4A).
